situation: The prod reconciliation job connects as role conciliacao_prod with query_timeout_s: 30 in config/jobs/prod.yaml. The role's own statement_timeout is 95s. That role setting overrides the RDS parameter group value of 60s, and staging uses a different config and role with 300s.
must_keep: Keep the prod.yaml snippet showing that the conciliacao job uses db_role conciliacao_prod and has query_timeout_s on line 15. Also keep the pg_roles output showing conciliacao_prod with statement_timeout=95s.
may_drop: The log traces, the rg listing, the staging yaml, the terraform parameter group, the assistant's 60s guesses, cron checks, git, test and build noise can all go.
why_judges_fail: Several blocks share the same key name (query_timeout_s, statement_timeout) with different values: 60s in the parameter group, 300s on the staging role, 20s on the read-only role. The assistant summary also confidently says 60s and repeats the goal's wording. A judge can easily keep those and drop the short role row that actually wins.
